title: What can Gemini do in Gmail?

body.text: Gemini is built into Gmail to
summarize emails, suggest draft replies, and create new emails from a short description
, making your inbox much easier and faster to manage.

example: "Draft a polite, professional email declining a meeting and proposing an alternative date."

title: Reply Suggestions and Summarize in Gmail

body.text: offers short reply options that fit the context of that email
, while Summarize condenses long emails or long threads down to just the key points.

example: "Summarize this thread for me — I replied late and want to know what was agreed."
